items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed, with high severity for new public exposure and security-sensitive releases. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security site facts are unknown across all 61 managed sites. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration validation, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance independently reports 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown sites. Exact decision: keep new public exposure, gated-product launches, and security-sensitive releases blocked pending dated evidence and owner-approved Security review. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves existing compliance boundaries. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, or request duplicate telemetry.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and private release gates
items.summary: Fleet-wide security clearance is unsupported because fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results and material preventive and detective controls remain unevidenced. This is not evidence of compromise or a certification finding. Maintain private gates for new public exposure, gated-product launch changes, and security-sensitive releases while continuing bounded read-only evidence work.
items.requested_action: Continue the existing consolidated security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deployment controls, TLS validation, dependency and supply-chain provenance, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, conduct external outreach, or request duplicate telemetry. Permit ordinary reversible growth only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, data-handling, and claims boundaries.
